text: pathway_sdaa_result **named list** element `data.frame` differential results one taxon (function), containing least columns `feature`, `logFC`, `p_adjust`, `group1`, `group2`, optionally `pathway_name`. top_n Integer. Maximum number bars (features) display per plot. function keeps strongest absolute effects, always keeps features `p_adjust <= padj_cutoff`. Default `15`. padj_cutoff Numeric. Adjusted p-value cutoff retaining significant features even among top `top_n` absolute effect. Default `0.05`. wrap_width Integer. Character width used line-wrap labels (via `stringr::str_wrap`). Default `45`.
